new_jobs.title: Manager, Selection Operations (Product Lifecycle Selection)
new_jobs.jd: **Company Introduction:** Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door. Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond. We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” **Role Overview:** Coupang Taiwan is seeking a Selection Operations Manager reporting to the Drop/PLCA lead. This role runs the drop and obsolete process on a day-to-day basis and leads a team of operators. The manager owns the quality, speed, and consistency of drop decisions while collaborating closely with BMs, Category leadership, Vendor Management, Catalog, and BI. This position requires a hands-on, owner mindset. The ideal candidate has a strong operational focus on productivity and accuracy, problem solving skills, ability to lead and coach teams, and provide clear communication to leadership. **Job Description** * Run the drop process end to end: intake, evidence check, approval, execution. * Apply the framework consistently. Reject where necessary. * Surface strategically important selection or unclear cases to leadership. * Check evidence against internal data and competitors. * Lead and coach operators on throughput, accuracy and turnaround. * Run quality audits and handle escalations. * Track and report performance regularly. * Fix root causes of poor requests with requestors. * Maintain SOPs, playbooks and training. Provide feedback for improvements. * Automate checks with BI and tech, including AI tools. **Basic Qualifications** * 5+ years in e-commerce, retail, catalog or category operations. * 2+ years leading an operations team. * Experience running rules-based processes with SLAs and audits. * Strong Excel or Google Sheets analysis. * Confident pushing back on stakeholders with evidence. * Fluent Mandarin; professional English. **Preferred Qualifications** * SQL and BI dashboards. * Product lifecycle, delisting or catalog quality experience. * Knowledge of the Taiwan e-commerce market. * Experience working with vendors or manufacturers. * Process improvement or SOP-building background. * Korean is a plus. **Recruitment Process** * Application Review - Phone Interview - Onsite (or Virtual Onsite) Interview – Offer * The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances. * Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e-mail address submitted at the application stage. **Details to Consider** * This job posting may be closed prior to the stated end date for application if all openings are filled. * Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process. * Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran’s benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws. **Privacy Notice** * Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below: https://www.coupang.jobs/privacy-policy/

new_jobs.title: Partnership Manager
new_jobs.jd: ***JOB DESCRIPTION*** ***Partnership Manager*** Location: Taipei, Taiwan Working Arrangement: Hybrid (On-site during probation) **About the Role** The Partnership Manager serves as a key bridge between Dot Connections and our global game providers, responsible for managing provider partnerships, product development, and market initiatives. The role helps our partners better understand Asian market needs while driving the successful introduction and growth of their products across target markets. In this role, you will translate market and client insights into actionable product and market strategies, working closely with providers and our Commercial, Marketing, and Technical teams to drive product launches, go-to-market strategies, campaigns, and ongoing product optimization. Your work will play an important role in strengthening product competitiveness and delivering sustainable commercial growth for our partners. **Key Responsibilities** 1.Collect and analyze client and market insights and competition strategies to make recommendations to direct manager and providers. 2.Gather business requirements for business analytics in the areas of drill-down analysis, dash boarding, reporting, visualization and data mining analysis. 3.Translate market requirements into product requirements to providers. 4.Plan go-to-market strategy together with the marketing team and providers. 5.Create and optimize ongoing campaigns. 6.Implement new launches, maintain growth in pillar products . 7.Ability to work out the basic technical concept in cooperation with the providers. 8.Present product proposals and features to developers and stakeholders and commercial team. 9.Organize and support jointed team to customer visit or technical promotion. 10.Create and deliver product training materials to enable services and support teams. 11.Maintain and develop the product list documents (for external/internal use) 12.Develop and implement B2B branding strategies to position Dot Connections as the gateway to Asia and beyond for game studios. 13.Work with iGaming media to generate positive coverage for Dot Connection. **Requirements** •Good command of English and Chinese to a professional level •Ability to provide the best support through excellent communication skills to business partners. •Time management ability **Join Us** At Dot Connections, the Partnership Manager goes beyond maintaining provider relationships. You will play a key role in connecting our providers, their products, and the Asian market, working directly with global game providers across product strategy, go-to-market planning, campaigns, product launches, and ongoing growth. If you are passionate about iGaming, products, and international business partnerships, and want to use your market insights and communication skills to help global partners expand across Asia, we invite you to join Dot Connections and build long-term, high-value partnerships with us.

**售前技術支持與客戶需求釐清** 支援業務、BDM、產品團隊進行客戶拜訪、技術簡報與產品方案說明。 與客戶討論應用場景、技術需求、系統環境、導入限制與期望成果。 協助判斷客戶需求是否適合現有產品、標準方案或需要進一步客製 / 整合評估。 將客戶需求轉換為初步技術架構、方案建議與導入方向。 協助業務辨識商機成熟度、技術可行性與潛在導入風險。 **二、Solution Proposal** **與架構設計支持** 根據客戶場景設計初步解決方案架構，包含系統組成、資料流程、部署方式、整合方式與使用情境。 協助撰寫或提供技術內容給 proposal、solution brief、簡報與 RFP / RFQ 回覆。 說明產品功能、系統架構、API / protocol、資料整合方式、雲端 / 邊緣部署模式等技術細節。 與產品、RD、SRE / DevOps、SI 或其他技術單位合作，釐清方案可行性與技術邊界。 協助建立可複製的 solution package、reference architecture 與 best practice。 **三、Demo** **、Promotion** **與展示環境建置** 建立與維護標準 Demo 環境，支援客戶展示、展會、研討會、內部 training 與 promotion 活動。 設計 Demo script、展示流程、操作步驟與說明素材，確保展示內容能清楚傳達產品價值。 依據不同產業或應用情境，將產品功能包裝成客戶容易理解的 use case。 協助產品推廣活動，包含 webinar、workshop、training、展覽與客戶參訪展示。 定期優化 Demo 環境穩定性、展示內容完整度與客戶體驗。 **四、** **Trial / PoC** **規劃與技術引導** 協助客戶進行 Trial 開通、使用引導、初步設定與標準驗證流程。 協助定義 PoC 目標、範圍、驗收條件、時程與成功標準。 評估 PoC 所需技術資源、系統環境、資料來源、整合方式與潛在風險。 在 PoC 過程中提供技術諮詢、問題釐清與必要的 troubleshooting 支持。 協助整理 Trial / PoC 結果，提出下一步導入建議或產品改善回饋。 Reference: https://wise.advantech.com/zh-tw **必要條件** * 大學以上學歷，資工、資管與電腦軟體應用相關科系。 * 具 3 年以上技術支持、Solution Engineer、Pre-sales Engineer、FAE、SA、系統整合或軟體 / 雲端 / IoT 相關工作經驗。 * 具備客戶技術溝通、需求訪談、產品展示、Demo、PoC 或系統導入經驗。 * 曾參與 B2B 軟體、SaaS、IoT、Edge Computing、雲端平台、工業軟體或系統整合相關產品者尤佳。 **技能能力** * 具備基礎系統架構理解能力，能說明前端、後端、資料庫、API、雲端、邊緣裝置或資料整合等基本概念。 * 熟悉至少一種雲端或系統部署環境，例如 Linux、Docker、Kubernetes、Azure、AWS、GCP 或私有雲環境。 * 具備 API、RESTful、MQTT、Modbus、OPC UA、資料串接或系統整合相關基礎知識。 * 能閱讀與分析基本 log、錯誤訊息、系統狀態與技術文件，並進行初步 troubleshooting。 * 具備製作技術簡報、solution proposal、demo script、training material 或 technical note 的能力。 * 具備英文技術文件閱讀能力，能以英文撰寫基本技術內容或回覆技術問題。 **加分條件** * SCADA / HMI / 智慧工廠 / 能源管理系統經驗 * Web Application 開發與維運經驗 * Kubernetes / Docker 容器化架構經驗 * 雲端平台（Azure / AWS / GCP）使用經驗 * 熟悉 DevOps / CI/CD 流程 * 具 AI 模型部署或 Edge AI 經驗

new_jobs.jd: **Job Description** Help clients put payments solutions into use smoothly and with confidence. You will manage project risks and timelines, keep clients informed, and ensure onboarding meets relevant controls and regulatory requirements. You will also identify ways to make onboarding simpler and more efficient. **Job Responsibilities** * Lead client onboarding from solution planning through testing and go-live, keeping deliverables on track. * Build strong client relationships, understand business needs, and explain onboarding requirements and next steps. * Gather and document requirements, then turn them into clear plans, actions, owners, and timelines. * Run client workshops and meetings to confirm needs, resolve questions, and agree on implementation plans. * Coordinate work across internal teams to complete onboarding activities and address delays or issues. * Manage project risks, dependencies, and escalations, keeping clients and stakeholders informed. * Ensure required legal, risk, compliance, and control steps are completed before go-live. * Identify process improvements that reduce delays and effort and improve the client experience. * Contribute to broader improvements in onboarding processes and ways of working. **Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills** * Bachelor Degree * Minimum 5 years of experience in client onboarding, project delivery, client service, operations, transaction banking, corporate finance, or payments. * Experience in a client-facing role, with the ability to understand client needs and manage expectations. * Strong project coordination skills, including managing plans, timelines, risks, and multiple workstreams. * Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships and work across teams. * Ability to work independently in a global, cross-functional environment. * Strong ownership, sound judgement, and a careful, organised approach to delivery. **Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills** * Experience in payments, transaction banking, corporate finance, financial technology, or merchant acquiring. * Familiarity with payment file and data transfer methods, such as application programming interfaces, Secure File Transfer Protocol, ISO 20022, or SWIFT. * Experience with automation or artificial intelligence tools, such as Alteryx, UiPath, or Python. * Familiarity with finance or treasury systems such as SAP, Oracle, Kyriba, or treasury management systems. * Project management or information technology service management certification. **ABOUT US** J.P. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Department:** Infrastructure – Technical Program Management **Reports to:** Director, TPM – Global Data Center Delivery **About the Role** GMI Cloud is expanding its global AI infrastructure footprint with multi-megawatt data center clusters across the U.S. and Asia. We are seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the management and delivery of GPU cluster infrastructure, including partner sites. This role will work at the intersection of AI hardware platforms, high-performance networking, and data center infrastructure, coordinating across solution architects, engineering teams, vendors, and contractors to deliver production-ready AI clusters. In this role, you will lead multi-disciplinary programs across procurement, engineering, and operations, ensuring on-time, on-budget, and high-quality delivery of data center infrastructure projects. You’ll drive alignment among internal stakeholders and external partners, while establishing scalable processes and performance metrics for GMI Cloud’s fast-growing deployment portfolio. **Responsibilities** * Coordinate programs for GMI GPU cluster planning, provisioning, and lifecycle management (procure, deploy, retire). * Partner with internal stackholders, procurement, infrastructure architect, SRE, BD/Sales teams to translate customer needs into execution plans. * Drive cross-team coordination spanning multiple timezones: define milestones, manage dependencies, surface risks, and ensure timely delivery. * Establish KPIs: utilization, provisioning lead time and implement SLA frameworks, execution runbook, incident playbooks and post-incident reviews. * Drive process standardization and vendors/partners accountability across multiple regional projects; introduce automation initiatives to reduce manual toil. * Lead vendor and partner engagements, manage procurement timelines and contracts as needed. * Communicate program status, trade-offs, and roadmap to senior leadership and stakeholders.. **Qualifications** * 5+ years technical program management experience, with 2+ years focused on infrastructure, platform, or compute resource programs (preferably AI/GPU clusters). * Strong technical background (BS/MS in CS, Engineering, or equivalent) with hands-on familiarity of Linux, orchestration (Kubernetes), and distributed storage/networking concepts. * Track record coordinating cross-functional engineering organizations, resolving dependencies, and delivering complex infrastructure projects on schedule. * Proven experience managing programs across distributed multi-timezone teams (US, APAC). * Strong program management fundamentals: scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, and change control. * Data-driven: experience defining and tracking operational KPIs and driving improvements. * Excellent written and verbal communication, documentation, stakeholder management skills. * Experience with on-prem datacenter deployments, and procurement cycles. * Flexible working hours and willingness to attend critical meetings outside standard local business hours; ability to travel domestically and internationally as required * PMP, Agile/scrum or equivalent project management certification preferred.
